title: Algorithms: synoptic exam challenge
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: Match the algorithm to the task — Quicksort partitions an array. Dijkstra finds shortest routes on non-negative weighted graphs. A* adds a remaining-cost estimate.
Show all required intermediate states — For quicksort write arrays after partition. For shortest paths maintain distances, predecessors and a clear visited or frontier order.
Explain efficiency and preconditions — State when each algorithm is appropriate and how its method changes work.
Exam command words matter — Trace = show states. Explain = give a cause or reason. Compare = connect similarities and differences with evidence.
